desc:
🚨 The Inspectors are coming! 🚨

Clean the Nuclear Facility with your friends… and find out your Boss’s BIG secret. 👀

How to play:
📦 Sort items into correct positions
🧼 Clean up nuclear goo
💰 Earn cash to upgrade your abilities!

✅ Finish 100% to unlock the SECRET ENDING - you won’t believe what happens! 

💾 Party leader’s round progress data saves for chosen difficulty.

If you enjoyed please LIKE 👍 FAVORITE ⭐ and JOIN our group Honey Brick for updates!
